# A04-S02: First training

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Have a couple of good news :-)

I thought you would like to see the very, very first test with a
beta version of the chatbot. I have now fine-tuned GPT-3 on small 77 pages
of material, which I have collected from various small parties’ websites and
social media. That gives a data set of 938 units, and I think we need
to get up to about three times that before it’s nailed. The attached is
'its first words'.

So this is kind of a rib from the skeleton (to be a bit biblical),
or how GPT-3 ‘looks’ when it has learned what a citizen-driven
political party is in Denmark.

Now I want to learn what it can do, and post with it, and then try
new ways to collect data in more direct interaction with real
people – cf. *Life with Artificials* ;-)

Furthermore, I have won the KP Digital Prize 2022 for my work at
the Easter exhibition. It will be announced on Saturday. I am so happy about that, and
it should also make it easier to gather more attention for our project
:-)

Hope everything is well with you, and let’s have a meeting soon – possibly with [████]
also?
